messages:
jordan: Quick prelaunch check — we go into change window tonight 23:00 PT. Are we ready for freeze? Breaking down: rollback plan, version pin, release notes link, smoke tests, and exceptions.

deploy-bot: Change window scheduled: 2026-03-20T23:00:00-07:00. Auto-canary enabled. Notifying oncall.

maya: All release notes pushed: https://redwood.atlassian/notes/RI-2.1.0 — includes schema changes and metrics dashboard entries. :white_check_mark:

samir: Rollback plan is here:
```
1) Route traffic to stable pool
2) Pin model to v2.0.1
3) Revert infra canary (5m observation)
4) If errors >1% abort and incident
```
I'll be on-call during window.

ops-oncall: @samir can you confirm the pinned image tag? Need exact tag for deploy-bot.

samir: pinned tag `redwood/inference:v2.0.1-20260320` — we've cross-verified with staging. I also updated the pin file in deploy config.

product-qa: Smoke tests: embedding latencies under 120ms, generation latency under 600ms. I ran a full run on staging, attached logs. :eyes:

lucy: Small docs-only change to the onboarding template — can we patch after freeze? It's non-prod facing.

jordan: Docs-only exceptions OK if merged to `docs/*` branch and deploy-bot excludes runtime changes. @deploy-bot confirm.

deploy-bot: Exception rule applied: docs merges allowed during freeze if label `docs-only` present. All other PR merges blocked.

maya: One outstanding: Canary ramp policy — current config increments 10/25/50/100. Recommend hold at 25 for first 30m.

jordan: Agreed. @deploy-bot set canary steps to `10,25,25,40` and pause 30m after 25. Also enable auto-rollback threshold 0.75% error.

deploy-bot: Canary config updated. Auto-rollback threshold set to 0.75%. Change window locked.

ops-oncall: Acknowledge. I have runbooks open. Will monitor traces and cost metrics during ramp. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks team — last call for anything else before freeze. If no objections, we proceed on schedule.

maya: No objections. Good to go from my side.

product-qa: Good from QA.

samir: Ready.
